Port Charlotte FAQs

Questions from Port Charlotte homeowners

Do you service Port Charlotte, Florida?

Yes. Acosta Pro Aluminum Screen serves Port Charlotte and the surrounding Charlotte County area, covering ZIP codes 33948, 33952, 33953, 33954, 33980, 33981. Call 941-565-5576 or 941-879-4211 for a free on-site estimate.

How much does pool cage rescreening cost in Port Charlotte?

Rescreening is priced per panel, so cost depends on panel count, cage height and the mesh you choose. We do not quote it over the phone because a sight-unseen number is either revised on the day or padded up front. The on-site estimate is free and written.

How quickly can you get to Port Charlotte?

Port Charlotte is inside our normal service area, so estimates are usually scheduled within a few days and work within the following week. Storm damage and doors that will not close get prioritized.

What screen do you recommend for Port Charlotte homes?

On canal-front lots, no-see-um mesh is not optional — standard 18/14 will not keep the midges out on a still evening.
